title: infrastructure-weekly-update-2026-05-18
body:
Summary:
This week focused on regional capacity smoothing ahead of two incoming Dedicated contracts (early June) and the ramp for the beta Private deployment in eu-west-1. We completed the H100 packing changes for multi-tenant pools, resolved a transient autoscaler regression, and advanced the cross-region routing policy for cost-aware fallback.

Key metrics (week ending 2026-05-17):
- Total fleet (active): 740 GPUs across 4 regions. Breakdown: us-west-2: 300 (160 H100, 120 A100-80), us-east-1: 200 (120 H100, 80 A100-80), eu-west-1: 140 (80 H100, 60 A100-80), ap-southeast-1: 100 (100 L4).
- Average GPU utilization (serving/runtime): 62% global (p95 latency SLO maintained).
- Spot preemption rate (us-west-2): 1.8% (down from 3.4% last week after scheduler changes).
- Queue depth (peak 95th percentile): 42 requests/minute (down 12% thanks to prefix cache warmups).
- Autoscaler: successful scale events: 68, failed scale events: 2 (both related to legacy instance profile limits; fixed midweek).

Highlights / Completed work:
1) H100 packing improvements (Mateo, Claire)
- Merged PR #721 that improves bin-packing heuristics for mixed-size H100 instances in Dedicated pools. Expected outcome: 8-12% lower per-token cost for H100-heavy tenants under bursty loads.
- Regression tests added to the cluster-sim harness. No performance regressions seen in the 48-hour soak.

2) Autoscaler regression resolved (Jordan)
- On Tuesday we observed a condition where the scale-down cooldown was ignored under high churn leading to flapping in small pools. Root cause: race in the cooldown timer when multiple scale signals arrived for the same pool.
- Fix deployed (hotfix v2.12.3) and verified in canary region (eu-west-1). Monitoring shows stable behavior for 72 hours.

3) Region capacity planning & Dedicated commitments (Priya, Aisha)
- Two incoming Dedicated deals (combined committed GPUs: ~120 H100 equivalent) with expected start dates: 2026-06-08 and 2026-06-15.
- Plan: reserve 40 H100 eq capacity in us-west-2 and 80 H100 eq across us-east-1 + eu-west-1. We will convert spare A100 capacity via priority routing where possible; ops runbook updated.
- Action: finalize nodetype procurement quote by EOD 2026-05-21 (Priya).

4) Private beta - eu-west-1 onboarding (Aisha)
- Beta customer network validation completed; initial cluster template and KMS config approved by security.
- Remaining blocker: automated benchmarking (loadgen + regression harness) still failing for long-sequence streams on the 4x L4 profile. Investigation ongoing; suspected kernel mismatch in the runtime build.

Incidents / Oncall notes:
- 2026-05-13 03:20 UTC: transient 502 errors in hosted API for ~8 minutes due to a control-plane cache stall after a config push. Mitigation: reset service config cache. Root cause: cache invalidation ordering for route updates; follow-up patch scheduled.
- 2026-05-15 11:47 UTC: lost monitoring alerts for ap-southeast-1 for ~25 minutes (alerting endpoint certificate rotation failure). Ops runbook updated to include certificate roundtrip test.

Risks / Blockers:
- H100 supply lead times: 6-8 weeks for new procurement quotes. If both Dedicated deals accelerate, we may need temporary burst partners (cloud spare pools) to meet early SLAs. Finance is evaluating short-term OPEX vs capital purchase.
- Private beta long-sequence perf regression on L4 nodes blocks automated sign-off; needs runtime CI fix to match kernel flags.

Planned work (next 7 days):
- Finalize procurement and reserve capacity for Dedicated deals (Priya, Aisha).
- Finish runtime kernel patch for L4 long-sequence perf and run full regression (Claire, Mateo).
- Deploy autoscaler telemetry improvements to better surface cooldown/rate-limit events (Jordan).
- Run cross-region load test (us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 fallback) to validate routing policies under simulated regional outage (SRE + Platform).
- Update cost model dashboard with new packer efficiency numbers post-PR #721 (FinOps + Platform).

Action items (owners):
- Priya: procurement quote and decision doc for additional H100 capacity - due 2026-05-21.
- Mateo: follow up on kernel flags for L4 items and produce short repro - due 2026-05-20.
- Claire: validate Dedicated canary deployment plan and confirm rollback hooks - due 2026-05-19.
- Jordan: add autoscaler cooldown telemetry and alerting rule - due 2026-05-20.
- Aisha: schedule a capacity review sync with Sales/Customer Success for 2026-05-22.

Notes / FYI:
- Preliminary numbers from the packing changes show a 9% drop in token cost in canary tenants using H100 pools; we'll roll to 50% of traffic in us-west-2 next Tuesday pending additional soak.
- Consider adding a short-term cloud burst contract to cover early Dedicated ramp if procurement doesn't complete in time - discuss on Friday planning call.
- Cross-team sync scheduled: infra + product-hosted-api + sales on 2026-05-20 to align on SLA expectations for Dedicated deals.

Meeting logs (standup highlights):
- Monday 2026-05-18 team standup: focus on procurement req, L4 regression, autoscaler telemetry.
- Wednesday 2026-05-13 postmortem sync: outlined cache invalidation fix and rollout plan.
- Thursday 2026-05-14 private-beta gating review: security sign-off done; perf gating remains.

Attachments / linked items:
- JIRA-INFRA-4872: H100 packing heuristics (PR#721).
- JIRA-INFRA-4920: Autoscaler cooldown race (hotfix deployed v2.12.3).
- confluence.redwood.ai/gpu-capacity-plan-2026: working doc with procurement timelines and cost scenarios.
- github.com/redwood-inference/infra/PR#721: packing changes and tests.

If you want a short slide deck version for the exec sync, I can prepare a 3-slide summary focussing on capacity commitments, current utilization, and blockers (will tag Sales + Finance).

-- Aisha
